about.description: Ink Ornament was born from the union of modern technique, visual composition and ornamental details. Every piece is designed with calm, intention and respect for the skin.
contact.title: Tell us your idea and book a consultation

services.page.title: Services designed to turn your idea into a real piece
services.page.description: We treat every tattoo as a unique piece: from the initial idea to the final design, session and aftercare.
services.detail.0.title: Custom design
services.detail.0.description: We start from your idea, references, body placement and desired style to create a unique composition. We do not copy generic pieces: we adapt the design so it has intention, balance and good readability on the skin.
services.detail.1.title: Fine line
services.detail.1.description: Ideal for delicate, clean and subtle pieces. This style requires precision, line control and the right size choice so the tattoo keeps its clarity over time.
services.detail.2.title: Blackwork
services.detail.2.description: Black ink tattoos with strong contrast and visual presence. It works very well for ornamental, geometric, symbolic or more character-driven compositions.
services.detail.3.title: Cover up
services.detail.3.description: We analyze the existing tattoo, its size, darkness and placement to propose a realistic solution. A good cover up does not just hide: it transforms the problem into a better designed piece.
services.detail.4.title: Ornamental tattoo
services.detail.4.description: Designs inspired by symmetry, decorative lines, arches, scrollwork and classic details. This style is perfect for people looking for an elegant, structured piece with visual identity.
services.detail.5.title: Pre-tattoo consultation
services.detail.5.description: Before getting tattooed, we answer questions about size, placement, pain, session duration, design aging and aftercare. The goal is to help you make a clear decision, not an impulsive one.
cta.services.title: Already have an idea for your tattoo?
cta.services.description: Tell us what you want, where you would like to place it and what style interests you. We will help you shape it before booking.
styles.page.title: Find the style that best tells your idea
styles.page.description: Every style has a different intention. Some are delicate and subtle; others are bold, dark and visually strong. Choosing the right style helps your tattoo age better and feel more visually coherent.
styles.detail.0.title: Fine line
styles.detail.0.description: Perfect for delicate, small or subtle pieces. It works very well for quotes, symbols, flowers, minimalist pieces and clean line designs.
styles.detail.0.bestFor: Best for: subtle, elegant and discreet pieces.
styles.detail.1.title: Blackwork
styles.detail.1.description: A style based on black ink, strong contrast and visually weighted shapes. It is excellent for symbolic, geometric, ornamental or powerful pieces.
styles.detail.1.bestFor: Best for: bold, contrasted and long-lasting designs.
styles.detail.2.title: Ornamental
styles.detail.2.description: Inspired by symmetry, architecture, arches, scrollwork, frames and classic details. It gives an elegant, structured and artistic feeling.
styles.detail.2.bestFor: Best for: elegant, decorative pieces with identity.
styles.detail.3.title: Realism
styles.detail.3.description: Focused on representing images with volume, shadows, texture and depth. It can be used for portraits, animals, objects or more complex compositions.
styles.detail.3.bestFor: Best for: faces, animals, objects and visual scenes.
styles.detail.4.title: Lettering
styles.detail.4.description: Focused on quotes, names or words with typographic composition. The most important parts are readability, correct size and placement.
styles.detail.4.bestFor: Best for: quotes, names, dates and meaningful words.
styles.detail.5.title: Minimal
styles.detail.5.description: Simple, clean and direct designs. Even when they look simple, they require good proportion so they do not feel empty or improvised.
styles.detail.5.bestFor: Best for: first tattoos or small meaningful pieces.
styles.guide.title: How do you choose the right style?
styles.guide.description: Do not choose only because something is trendy. The best style depends on your idea, body placement, size, detail tolerance and how you want it to look over time.
styles.guide.item.0: If you want something discreet: fine line or minimal.
styles.guide.item.1: If you want visual presence: blackwork or ornamental.
styles.guide.item.2: If you want to represent something real: realism.
styles.guide.item.3: If you want a quote or name: lettering.
cta.styles.title: Not sure which style to choose?
cta.styles.description: Send us your idea and a few references. We will help you choose a visual direction that makes sense for your piece.

about.page.title: A private studio focused on intentional pieces
about.page.description: Ink Ornament brings together modern technique, visual composition and ornamental details to create custom tattoos with character, balance and respect for the skin.
about.story.title: We do not make generic tattoos: we design pieces with intention
about.story.description: Every tattoo starts with a conversation. We want to understand the idea, the meaning, the body placement and the aesthetic you want to achieve. From there, we build a piece that does not only look good on day one, but keeps its coherence over time.
about.values.title: What guides our work
about.values.item.0.title: Intentional design
about.values.item.0.description: Every line, shadow and proportion should have a visual reason. We avoid filling the skin without purpose.
about.values.item.1.title: Clean technique
about.values.item.1.description: We prioritize precision, hygiene, proper preparation and careful execution.
about.values.item.2.title: Own aesthetic
about.values.item.2.description: We mix ornamental art, black ink, fine lines and elegant composition.
about.values.item.3.title: Clear communication
about.values.item.3.description: We explain possibilities, limits and aftercare so you can make a good decision.
about.safety.title: Hygiene, preparation and respect for your skin
about.safety.description: A good experience does not depend only on the design. The space preparation, materials, session care and aftercare instructions also matter.
about.safety.item.0: Sterilized and disposable materials when appropriate.
about.safety.item.1: Work area prepared before every session.
about.safety.item.3: Designs adapted to placement, size and natural skin aging.

contact.faq.title: Questions before booking
contact.faq.item.0.question: Can I ask for guidance if I am not sure about the design?
contact.faq.item.0.answer: Yes. You can send a general idea and a few references. We will help you choose style, size and visual direction.
contact.faq.item.1.question: Do I need to pay before the session?
contact.faq.item.1.answer: That depends on the studio policy. A deposit is commonly requested to reserve the date and prepare the design.
contact.faq.item.2.question: Can I bring a reference image?
contact.faq.item.2.answer: Yes, but we will use it as a starting point. The goal is to create an original piece, not copy another tattoo exactly.
contact.faq.item.3.question: Do you work with cover ups?
contact.faq.item.3.answer: Yes, but we need to see the current tattoo first to know which options are viable.
process.title: How we take your idea to the skin
process.description: A good tattoo does not start with the needle. It starts with a clear idea, an honest conversation and a design made for your body.
process.items.0.title: Initial idea
process.items.0.description: You tell us what you want to tattoo, what it means and which visual references you have.
process.items.1.title: Consultation
process.items.1.description: We review placement, size, style, viability and doubts before moving forward.
process.items.2.title: Design
process.items.2.description: We prepare a visual proposal adapted to your body and to the intention of the piece.
process.items.3.title: Session
process.items.3.description: We tattoo the piece with preparation, hygiene, calm and attention to detail.
process.items.4.title: Aftercare
process.items.4.description: We give you clear instructions to take proper care of the piece during healing.
